prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the interior of a bustling fire station is depicted with precise detail. On the left side of the frame, a firefighter in a yellow helmet stands tall, holding a polished brass bell that gleams under the overhead lights. Next to him, a small black cat sits calmly on a wooden bench, its green eyes fixed intently on the dangling rope of the bell. In the center, a woman in a blue uniform leans against a large red fire truck, her arms crossed confidently as she observes the scene. Beside her, a dalmatian puppy lies sprawled on the concrete floor, chewing happily on a bright orange rubber bone. To the right, an older man in a gray coat points emphatically at a detailed map pinned to the corkboard wall, his expression serious and focused. A young boy in a striped shirt looks up at the map with wide curiosity, standing just inches away from the pointing man. Behind them, a shiny silver ladder rests vertically against the wall, reflecting the ambient light. Hanging from the ceiling near the center is a coiled white hose, secured neatly by metal brackets. On the far right edge, a janitor in green overalls sweeps dust into a pile, his broom moving rhythmically across the tiles. Above the main bay door, a digital clock displays the time in bright red LEDs. There is no smoke visible in the air, keeping the atmosphere clear and crisp. There is no fire present anywhere in the station, ensuring a sense of calm readiness rather than emergency chaos. The firefighter in the yellow helmet hands a clipboard to the woman in the blue uniform, who accepts it with a nod. The black cat reaches out a paw toward the dalmatian puppy, creating a playful tension between the two animals. The young boy in the striped shirt stands next to the older man in the gray coat, mirroring his interest in the strategic layout. The janitor in green overalls pauses briefly, looking at the coiled white hose above him before resuming his task.
